description: Answers an agent's question with one click per question instead of two. A countdown starts the moment you pick an option, then presses the widget's own Next or Submit answer button. It appears under the option you picked and leads with a Stop button, and space or Escape stops it as well. Picking again, another option or the same one, restarts it from the full delay of 4 seconds, adjustable from 1 to 120. It never picks an option and never types free text, and it stands down by itself whenever pressing the button would be wrong, such as nothing selected or the free-text box open.
